text:
Predicates:
Podcast(x) ::: x is a podcast.
Novel(x) ::: x is a novel.
BornIn(x, y) ::: x was born in y.
American(x) ::: x is American.
WrittenBy(x, y) ::: x is written by y.
Author(x, y) ::: x is the author of y.
Book(x) ::: x is a book.
Create(x, y) ::: x created y.
FamilyHistory(y) ::: y is Family History.
FamilySecrets(x) ::: x is Family Secrets.
PublishedIn(y, z) ::: y was published in year z.
City(y) ::: y is a city.

Premises:
¬Podcast(FamilySecrets) ::: A podcast is not a novel.
∀x (BornIn(x, Boston) → American(x)) ::: If a person is born in Boston, then the person is American.
∀x (Novel(y) ∧ WrittenBy(y, x)) → Author(x, y) ∧ Book(y) ::: If a book y is a novel and written by x, then x is the author of y and y is a book.
American(DaniShapiro) ::: Dani Shapiro is American.
WrittenBy(FamilyHistory, DaniShapiro) ::: Family History is written by Dani Shapiro.
Novel(FamilyHistory) ::: Family History is a novel.
PublishedIn(FamilyHistory, 2003) ::: Family History was published in 2003.
Create(DaniShapiro, FamilySecrets) ::: Dani Shapiro created Family Secrets.
City(Boston) ::: Boston is a city.
AmericanCity(Boston) ::: Boston is an American city.

Conclusion:
Novel(FamilySecrets) ::: Family Secrets is a novel.
